lines: Ask the Space from the top search: type a question and get an answer with its sources, only from what you can read.
Agents learn from your corrections. Each lesson shows a Learned line you can undo, and you can turn learning off in Settings.
Hide parts of a file from AI: redact or highlight text, and set a folder to Redacted or Not available for agents.
Choose which AI account pays for an agent's own work and for each automation, with a backup when one runs out.
Tasks: keyboard on Board and Timeline, a warning before a guest gets a task, and no edit lost when two people save.
